owner_ruling: 2026-09-18: accepted as pre-A1 regression anchors, not as authorization for a pre-cutover fix; no ConsumesParam change before P-022 Stage 3

remeasured.why: P-022 Stage 3 (#262, merged as #359) made Rust the PUBLIC default engine. The `current` record above was measured at 70189a3, when a bare launcher invocation still meant Python, so it had to be re-taken before A1 could rest on it — and re-taken, not rewritten. Re-measured on both engines explicitly, at origin/main 63148d0 plus the A1.0 port, which adds no code under frontend/, ownlang/ or rust/ (verified: the port's changed-path set contains none).
remeasured.result: UNCHANGED — both engines reproduce the `current` record above exactly, on both layers. Stage 3 moved none of this control, which is what the two-layer design predicted: the fabricated release is decided in the Roslyn extractor, before either engine runs.

note: Same mechanism as row 18a; the alias write must disqualify the guard (fail-closed) and the call must not fabricate a consume.
